added.summary: Pack slots for an ability slot on a HUD's ability bar: Ability.box (its side; .ultimate), Ability.frame (shape and rim; .ultimate, .ready, .disabled), Ability.face (.ultimate: its inset is the charge ring's width), Ability.ring and Ability.ring.fill (the ultimate's charge), Ability.sweep (.ultimate), Ability.count and Ability.chip.ult, .ready, .key and .charges. A theme recipe dresses them from its own slot art, and a theme sets their sizes.

Design tokens for the combat HUD, each a theme's to set: duration-ready-pulse, -flash, -damage, -damage-stagger, -trail-hold, -trail, -hit and -arc; scale-ready-pulse, -damage-pop and -combo-pop; opacity-sweep and -flash; and the stroke arc. The scifi, candy, tactical and anime themes set their own.

Draws every part from the Ability slots, so it takes the theme's shape, art, sizes and glow. The ultimate's charge fills round it clockwise from the top, a cooldown sweeps round the art instead of a veil from the top, and a full ultimate shows Ready (shooter.abilities.ready) under it, its charge in figures while it fills.
